Three High-Priority Features: All Implemented ✅

1. Compact Header Mode (Responsive Density Controls)

Status: ✅ PASS
Implementation: 100%

  • Three-button toggle: Min (32px) / Auto (responsive) / Detail (125px)
  • Responsive breakpoint at 600px viewport height
  • Minimal mode preserves all essential controls (sort, filter, anchor, type icon)
  • localStorage persistence: dtsmartr-header-density
  • Verified in browser: Buttons functional, headers collapse correctly

Code locations: - Lines 8-9: Constants (HEADER_HEIGHT_COMPACT_BASE = 48) - Lines 3500-3512: Dynamic height calculation with useMemo - Lines 3596-3634: Toolbar UI controls

2. Side-Panel Advanced Filter (Live Preview)

Status: ✅ PASS
Implementation: 100%

  • Collapsible 360px right-side drawer (flex layout)
  • Draft state prevents accidental filtering
  • Live preview: yellow highlight on matching rows (rgba(254, 240, 138, 0.35))
  • 3px yellow left border on row numbers (#eab308)
  • Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+F toggles panel
  • Verified in code: Panel structure, draft state management, highlight logic

Code locations: - Line 2826: draftQueryRules state - Line 3836-3878: Live preview highlight logic - Line 3250: Keyboard shortcut handler - Lines 3938+: Panel container

3. Shift+Click Multi-Column Sorting

Status: ✅ PASS
Implementation: 100%

  • Click: Sort single column (asc → desc → clear)
  • Shift+Click: Add column to sort chain
  • Numbered emoji badges: 1️⃣ ↑, 2️⃣ ↓, 3️⃣ ↑ (priority 1-9)
  • Toolbar displays sort chain: “↕ USUBJID asc (1)”
  • “Clear sort” button removes entire chain
  • Verified in browser: Badge visible on header, toolbar shows sort chain

Code locations: - Line 2809: sortState as ordered array - Lines 3440-3487: handleSort with Shift+Click logic - Lines 2444-2469: Badge rendering with emoji - Lines 3565-3577: Toolbar sort chain display
